prerequisites: python3 (Python 3.9 or newer) available on the host
loopback TCP port 9700 (or the configured OPERATOR_UI_PORT) can be bound by the operator application

configuration_inputs.name: OPERATOR_UI_PORT
configuration_inputs.description: TCP port the operator application binds. Defaults to 9700; overridable via --port or the OPERATOR_UI_PORT environment variable.

readiness.condition: GET /api/health returns HTTP 200 with body app == reach-lite-operator

cleanup_operation: Send SIGTERM to the operator application process; if it has not exited within 5 seconds, send SIGKILL. The application is stateless and starts no external services, so no further cleanup is required.
